description: PR #67, Sourcery's review of commit 67551bd — the same file contents as b391162, re-pushed. One finding.

comments.body:
**issue (bug_risk):** The code assumes the JSON top-level is always a dict; a non-dict payload will raise at runtime when calling `.get`.

If the JSON is malformed or the schema changes so the top-level is not a dict, `data.get(...)` will raise `AttributeError`. Consider guarding with `isinstance(data, dict)` and returning the default (or raising a clearer error) to make this more robust to unexpected contents.
